commenti.body: One thing I want to push back against is the idea that streamers are more 'real' than movies and tv shows. Most streamers are playing exaggerated versions of themselves and are engaging in scripted situations/feuds/controversies to drive traffic. They have more in common with reality TV and pro wrestling than they do with the real world.

I got upset reading that streamers were compared to Tarkovsky so I quit reading. Korine has made some great movies, but to me he's become a hack uninterested in cinema. He's obviously taking the piss and meant to shock, don't read into it too much.
Please stop taking this trolling imbecile's dissertation style shitpost seriously.

I've said it once, and I'll say it again. Please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please give me a bunch of Twitch-Kick streaming assholes/Radu Jude collaboration. Thank you very much!
